        public NumericNCWord GPause = new NumericNCWord("G{##}", 0);

        public NumericNCWord GCycle = new NumericNCWord("G{##}", 0);

        public NumericNCWord QThreadAngle = new NumericNCWord("Q{#####!###}", 0);

        public NumericNCWord Pcyc = new NumericNCWord("P{#####!###}", 0);

        public NumericNCWord Jcyc = new NumericNCWord("J{#####!###}", 0);
